title: [DOC-4] Google Business-tier "step-up" WebAuthn check verifies nothing and is mislabeled as the de
description: Review finding DOC-4: Google Business-tier "step-up" WebAuthn check verifies nothing and is mislabeled as the device-key PoP (lens DOC). Location: profiles/gsuite-employer-did.md:419, :421, :427-428, :514; profiles/o365-employer-did.md:555; spec/02-identity.md:80. Fix: The gsuite profile never registers a WebAuthn credential (grep for passkey/webauthn finds only :419-428 and :514). An assertion against a key that was never enrolled proves nothing about the user. o365:555 is a device-key signature, not a WebAuthn check, and spec/02-identity.md:80 says "A WebAuthn credential (passkey) is not a device key". Remove "same proof-of-possession check" and pick one of the options below. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
